name: bob-chainguard
description: IBM Bob migrates a web3.js + ethers v5 dApp to viem/wagmi; chainguard measures, plans and guards the migration.

scripts.scan:baseline: node chainguard/bin/chainguard.js scan legacy-dapp/src --format json --out reports/baseline.json && node chainguard/bin/chainguard.js scan legacy-dapp/src --format md --out reports/baseline.md
scripts.report: node chainguard/bin/chainguard.js scan legacy-dapp/src --baseline reports/baseline.json --format md --out reports/after.md
scripts.test: npm test --prefix chainguard && npm test --prefix legacy-dapp
